description:
## [2.3.0](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/releases/tag/v2.3.0) (pre-release re-cut)

- **Instagram (`com.instagram.android` `439.0.0.37.89`)**: Added 18 patches (distraction-free feed/Reels/stories/explore/notes/ads/buttons filters, MobileConfig & Tigon URL hooks, `Bypass signature check`, `Remove build expired popup`, and `Clone`) with 5 pure-Java extension helpers.
- **Meesho (#32)**: Updated target package to `com.meesho.supply` (`29.5`–`29.9`) and cleaned up `docs/MEESHO.md`.
- **Amazon (#21 / PR #31)**: Added Amazon Business (`com.amazon.mShop.android.business.shopping`) + Shopping `32.19.0.100`, `Disable screenshot detection`, expanded WebView AdBlock selectors (`amznkiller`), and WebView JS video autoplay blocking.
- **Mereframe (#5 / PR #33)**: Added BTI/PAC-safe ARM64 `.so` integrity + Pro gates (`libunnamed_raw.so`) alongside `LQu.k/m` and `Bf1c089.*` DEX hooks.
